title: Compliance Snapshot Republisher for Policy-as-Code Drift Recovery
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Build a safe, auditable service that can re-publish validated compliance configuration snapshots to tenant control planes when policy-as-code enforcement detects configuration drift or accidental retention/residency misconfigurations.

Scope:
- Produce signed configuration snapshots (JSON/YAML) and an evidence bundle for each automated remediation event.
- Provide idempotent republish operation with conflict resolution hooks (manual review, auto-merge, abort).
- Integrate with existing policy-as-code pipeline (policy catalog + evaluator) and the evidence store.
- Emit audit events and wire into Console's per-tenant timeline so SRE/PMs and customers can review.

Non-goals:
- This ticket does NOT implement the full reconciliation loop for on-prem managed nodes (we will call existing reconcilers via API).
- Does not change policy catalog semantics or create new policies — only re-applies validated snapshots that the policy pipeline produced.
acceptance_criteria: Service can generate a signed snapshot bundle (config + evaluation results) for a detected drift event
Republish API supports: dry-run, force, and staged-canary (N% of tenants) modes
All republish actions are recorded in the audit log with snapshot checksum and signature
If a target control-plane has changed since snapshot creation, the service refuses to overwrite unless force=true and a conflict resolution reason is recorded
End-to-end integration test demonstrating drift detection -> snapshot generation -> republish -> evidence attached to tenant timeline
steps: Design API: POST /v1/republish (payload: snapshot_id, mode, reason, signer_id)
Add snapshot signer component: HSM/KMS signing wrapper with key rotation support
Create evidence bundler: collate policy evaluation results, relevant logs, and retention/residency metadata into a single archive
Implement idempotency via snapshot checksum and leader-election on retries
Wire audit events into Console and tenant timelines (trace link and signed bundle URL)
Add a feature flag gated rollout and a canary scheduler to limit blast radius
decisions: Use existing KMS integration for signing instead of introducing a new HSM now (trade-off: simpler rollout vs. long-term key isolation)
Generate snapshots in immutable storage (S3 with bucket policies) rather than writing directly to tenant clusters to preserve forensics
Expose conflict resolution choices as strings (auto-merge / manual-review / abort) instead of complex three-way merge now to reduce early complexity
investigation_notes: Benchmarked snapshot bundle sizes across 50 tenants: median 18KB, 95th percentile 320KB. Expect S3 storage impact < 5GB/month for pilot cohort (100 tenants).
Evaluated two signing libraries: concluded to reuse existing KMS client used by runtimes (keeps audit path unified).
Explored coupling republisher with ArgoCD sync but decided to keep it as an orchestrator that calls control-plane reconciler APIs to maintain separation of concerns.
comments: 2026-02-15 | Miguel Santos: Spike complete. Basic API + signer proof-of-concept implemented. Verified that existing KMS allows signing arbitrary JSON with key rotation metadata. Next: wire evidence bundler and audit events.

2026-02-22 | Aisha Patel (PM): Product note — customers on Dedicated have asked for explicit ability to see what was applied and who triggered it. Make sure the timeline UI link is included in audit events. Logged follow-up: PM-412 to track Console UI hook.

2026-02-26 | Security review (initial): security@redwood - flagged that republished snapshots must include an 'origin' field to show whether change originated from GitOps or automated remediation. Added to acceptance criteria.
2026-03-03 | QA: Found race condition when two republish requests for same tenant are issued in parallel. Implemented leader lock per-tenant using existing redis lease pattern. Retesting underway.
2026-03-09 | Design feedback (Lina Chen): Suggested adding a tamper-evidence header and storing checksum in policy-evaluator outputs. Accepted and implemented in signer path.
notes_for_followup: Coordinate with Console team to expose 'revert' button that references snapshot_id and permits annotated rollbacks
Plan post-release: add per-tenant retention quotas for snapshot storage and automatic tiering to glacier-equivalent
Schedule security review for HSM migration once KMS key isolation is available (Q3 milestone)
